redFirst.basis: `python3 .claude/hooks/guard-release.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 1 of 103 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (named by --case, HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code, the task's run with its inline suite .claude/hooks/guard-release.py laid over as HEAD's copy plus its 1 test hunk(s), 4 other hunk(s) held at HEAD), each passing with the working tree's implementation - gr4r (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 102/103 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: guard-release.py gains _release_push(cfg_mod, rest): the words the shell runs are tools/release.py run directly or by a Python interpreter (interpreter options stepped over, -W/-X/-Q with their value), with --push or --push=... among the script's own arguments. _words_publishers asks it first and reports 'runs the release pipeline with --push'; the anchored fallback for an unbalanced clause gets the same arm through _RELEASE_AT. Without --push the pipeline stops before every remote step, so that form is not a publisher. Cases gr4r (five pushing forms incl. -u, a direct run, an absolute path and sh -c, plus two non-pushing forms) and gr4s (another script's --push, release.py inside an echo string, release_notes.py) were proven by mutation in a scratch copy: dropping the arm turns gr4r red, accepting any --push turns gr4s red; 103/103 with the change. Written by the orchestrator, since this is command-reading code in a guard hook.
outcome.descriptive: The release guard now treats `tools/release.py ... --push` as a publishing command, so the open-bug check and the #release-with-bugs bypass govern the release pipeline the same way they govern git tag and gh release.

testsAdded: .claude/hooks/guard-release.py: python3 tools/release.py --push is classified as a publishing command, and release.py without --push is not
